texts.title: 课文一
texts.scene: 白家月和安妮在打电话。

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.pinyin: Wǒ shàngwǔ shí diǎn shí fēn yǒu kè.
lines.english: I have a class at 10:10 in the morning.

lines.speaker: 安妮
lines.hanzi: 好的，我们下午两点见吧。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de, wǒmen xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn jiàn ba.
lines.english: Alright, let's meet at 2:00 in the afternoon.

texts.title: 课文二
texts.scene: 在校园里，李文遇到白家月。

lines.speaker: 李文
lines.hanzi: 下午我想去电影院看电影，你去吗？
lines.pinyin: Xiàwǔ wǒ xiǎng qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng, nǐ qù ma?
lines.english: I want to go to the cinema to watch a movie this afternoon. Are you going?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bù xiǎng qù, xiàwǔ hái yǒu shì.
lines.english: I don't want to go. I still have something to do this afternoon.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.hanzi: 我明天下午两点还上课呢，四点半下课。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn hái shàngkè ne, sì diǎn bàn xiàkè.
lines.english: I have a class tomorrow afternoon at 2:00 and it finishes at 4:30.

texts.scene: 王一雪在办公室给刘明打电话。

lines.english: I'll finish work at 6:30 in the evening.

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bā diǎn qù yīyuàn shàngbān.
lines.english: I'll go to work at the hospital at 8:00.

lines.speaker: 王一雪
lines.hanzi: 好的，你去店里买些菜吧。

lines.english: Alright, could you go to the store to buy some vegetables?

lines.speaker: 刘明
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ shí fēnzhōng hòu qù.
lines.english: Okay, I'll go in ten minutes.

data.passage: 白家月和安妮打电话。现在是早上八点四十。白家月上午十点十分有课。她们下午两点见。
data.passage_pinyin: Bái Jiāyuè hé Ānnī dǎ diànhuà. Xiànzài shì zǎoshang bā diǎn sìshí. Bái Jiāyuè shàngwǔ shí diǎn shí fēn yǒu kè. Tāmen xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn jiàn.
data.passage_en: Bai Jiayue and Annie talk on the phone. It is 8:40 in the morning. Bai Jiayue has class at 10:10 in the morning. They meet at 2:00 in the afternoon.

data.title: 课文二：电影和明天的安排
data.passage: 李文下午想去电影院看电影。他问白家月去不去。白家月不想去。她下午还有事。白家月明天下午两点还上课，四点半下课。
data.passage_pinyin: Lǐ Wén xiàwǔ xiǎng qù diànyǐngyuàn kàn diànyǐng. Tā wèn Bái Jiāyuè qù bu qù. Bái Jiāyuè bù xiǎng qù. Tā xiàwǔ hái yǒu shì. Bái Jiāyuè míngtiān xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn hái shàngkè, sì diǎn bàn xiàkè.
data.passage_en: Li Wen wants to go to the cinema to watch a movie in the afternoon. He asks whether Bai Jiayue will go. Bai Jiayue does not want to go. She still has something to do in the afternoon. Bai Jiayue still has class at 2:00 tomorrow afternoon and finishes class at 4:30.

data.title: 课文三：下班、上班和买菜
data.passage: 王一雪给刘明打电话。刘明在家里。王一雪晚上六点半下班。刘明八点去医院上班。刘明十分钟后去店里买菜。
data.passage_pinyin: Wáng Yīxuě gěi Liú Míng dǎ diànhuà. Liú Míng zài jiā li. Wáng Yīxuě wǎnshang liù diǎn bàn xiàbān. Liú Míng bā diǎn qù yīyuàn shàngbān. Liú Míng shí fēnzhōng hòu qù diàn li mǎi cài.
data.passage_en: Wang Yixue calls Liu Ming. Liu Ming is at home. Wang Yixue finishes work at 6:30 in the evening. Liu Ming goes to work at the hospital at 8:00. Liu Ming goes to the store to buy vegetables after ten minutes.

questions.question_en: What time does Wang Yixue finish work?

instructions.title: 第7课课后作业
instructions.summary: ClassPro 课后作业重点完成汉字书写、表达输出、个性化准备和课堂闭环，不重复练习册的大量客观题。
instructions.required: 必选：完成汉字书写任务。
instructions.optional: 可选：从写一段话、口语准备、学习反思中选择完成；鼓励用今天学过的词和句型。
instructions.aiPolicy: 准备口语话题时可以借助 AI 查词或打草稿，但请改成自己能说出来的中文。

default.label: 第7课课后作业
default.goal: 完成必选书写，并准备能在课堂上使用的表达。
default.suggestedMix: 必选：汉字书写；可选：写一段话、口语准备、学习反思。

default.prompt_cn: 必选：书写本课汉字：现、在、点、早、午、分、课、见、电、影、事、半、晚、医、院、班、菜、后
教学扩展：请随机从今天所学生词中选择3-5个，写一段话。
default.prompt_en: Optional: Randomly choose 3-5 words from today's vocabulary and write a short paragraph.
default.instructions: 可选生词：现在、点、早上、上午、下午、见、电影院、电影、事、上课、下课、晚上、医院、上班、店、菜、十分钟后。请至少用3个，最多用5个。
default.answerPlaceholder: 例如：我上午十点上课。下午两点我想看电影。晚上六点半我下课。

default.prompt_cn: 教学扩展：请准备话题“介绍你一天的时间安排”，下次上课时口头表达。
default.prompt_en: Optional speaking prep: Prepare the topic "介绍你一天的时间安排" for oral sharing next class.
default.instructions: 可以借助 AI 查词或整理草稿，但请改成自己能读、能说的中文。
default.answerPlaceholder: 例如：我上午十点上课。下午两点我想看电影。晚上六点半我下课。

default.prompt_cn: 教学扩展：今天哪一个词或句子最难？你想下次再练什么？
default.prompt_en: Optional reflection: Which word or sentence was hardest today? What do you want to practice next time?
default.answerPlaceholder: 例如：我觉得“六点半”最难。我想再练时间。

feedbackTemplates.defaultPraise: 已收到，写得不错，继续加油！
feedbackTemplates.defaultRevise: 请再检查字形、笔顺或表达是否准确。
